description: This Java class, ProgressiveLoanSummaryDataProvider, implements logic for providing loan summary data, specifically for progressive loans using advanced payment allocation strategy. It contains methods for calculating outstanding interests, handling transaction reprocessing, and integrating with loan schedules within the Fineract project.

classes.name: ProgressiveLoanSummaryDataProvider
classes.description: A Spring component class that extends CommonLoanSummaryDataProvider to provide specialized loan summary data for progressive loans following the advanced payment allocation strategy. It includes methods for calculating outstanding interest, reprocessing transactions, and assessing unpaid interest amounts.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Checks if the provided loan processing strategy code matches 'advanced-payment-allocation-strategy', indicating suitability for this provider.

methods.name: withTransactionAmountsSummary
methods.description: Overloaded methods that generate a LoanSummaryData object with transaction amounts, applying reprocessing and calculation logic for a specific loan and its repayment schedule.

methods.name: getRelatedRepaymentScheduleInstallment
methods.description: Retrieves the relevant repayment schedule installment based on the business date, excluding down payments and additional installments.

methods.name: calculateModel
methods.description: Reprocesses loan transactions to build an interest schedule model for the loan up to a specific business date, and logs any differences in reprocessed transactions.

methods.name: computeTotalUnpaidPayableNotDueInterestAmountOnActualPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the total interest amount that is unpaid and not yet due during the actual period, considering the loan's state, interest recalculation settings, and schedule data.
